name: cmsfit-data-v1
run: cd /work && python -m py_compile cmsfit.py test_cmsfit.py && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m unittest -v test_cmsfit > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -n 40 /out/tests.txt; exit $rc
cd /work && sha256sum cmsfit.py test_cmsfit.py AMENDMENT-CMSTOPO-0.1.1.md manifest.json | tee /out/sha256.txt && pip freeze > /out/versions.txt

cd /work && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 timeout 7000 python cmsfit.py --mode data --fetch manifest.json --skim-dir /work/skims --out-dir /out > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^CMSFIT_' /out/run.txt | cut -c1-600; tail -n 20 /out/run.txt; exit $rc
